<subject>Re: Any Plans tonight?</subject>
<body>
Hey Shaun! Sorry I didn’t get back to you on Friday. I left the office a bit early, so I must have missed your message. Did you all have a good night out on Friday? How’s everything going with you?

It’s been pretty hectic around here. I had to put in several late nights last week just to keep on top of everything. I might have to hold off on buying that new car with Halcyon’s shares taking a bit of a dip recently. They did bounce back some on Friday and early this morning though. Fingers crossed it continues to improve.

Have you spoken to Max since his wedding? Haven’t heard a peep from him. Probably just wrapped up in the whole newlywed thing.

 
 
 
 
 
"Palmer, Shaun" <shaun.palmer@halcyonbank.co.uk>  
22/03/2024 15:18  

To: clifford.jones@halcyonbank.co.uk  
Subject: Any Plans tonight?  

Hey, what’s up? My brother-in-law and a mate of his are flying into Leeds this evening. We’re planning to hit up The Ledger, which is supposed to be similar to The Vault. We’ll probably get there around 10:00. The plan is to hang out there for a bit, then head into the city centre to find some bar. A couple of my old uni friends will be joining us too. Thought you might want to come along. You in?

Drop me a line or call me at home: +44 113 294 3820, mobile: +44 7712 529 216. I’m wrapping up here soon, so if I don’t reply to email, just call.

Cheers,  
S


clifford.jones@halcyonbank.co.uk  
26/02/2024 13:39  
To: Shaun Palmer-Lay/US@Frito-Lay  
Subject: Re: Meridian Conference  

Shaun, thanks for sorting that out. I’ll probably get to Leeds before you. I’ll have my mobile on me: +44 7047 822161. If you arrive early, give me a ring. Otherwise, just call the hotel room when you check in. Sounds good, we can travel to the conference together. I might bring this girl I’ve been seeing along. My latest conquest. We’ll see. I think the conference starts at 7.

Thanks for the tip about the shopping centre. I was going to ask about that.

Clifford


Shaun.J.Palmer@fr  
itolay.com  
To: clifford.jones@halcyonbank.co.uk  
26/02/2024 12:09  
Subject: 2nd Room at The Parkside  

Clifford,

Good news – we managed to snag the second room at the same £129 rate. Below are two separate confirmation numbers – I don’t think it matters which you or I use. When you check in, just give one of those. They’re both on my card, so you can switch it to yours at check-in.

Not sure exactly when we’ll arrive since we’re flying in from Manchester. I expect to get there around 5:00 (the conference starts at 7:00, right?). We’ll actually be travelling up on Friday since some of Hilary’s family from Yorkshire will be attending as well.

If we don’t catch up before then, let’s plan to meet at the hotel between 6:00 and 6:30. We can get to the conference together from there.

By the way, they’re registered at Brockwell’s – we picked up a gift yesterday, but there’s still plenty left on their list.

Cheers,  
S
</body>
